outlook.statement: The Company's outlook remains same as stated earlier, that is to enhance the capacity utilization of the existing installed capacity across various product lines. Your company looks to increase the capacity utilization thus improve the bottom line.

India's macroeconomic landscape is projected to remain robust, retaining its position as a leading global growth engine. RBI estimates real GDP growth for FY 2026-27 at 6.7% to 6.9%. Continued government capital outlays on infrastructure projects, coupled with a steady uptick in private sector investments due to high capacity utilization levels, will provide strong tailwinds for manufacturing, construction, and engineered wood-panel industries.
